title: Twisted Gelfand-Ponomarev modules
summary: In this expository paper, given a field $K$ and two automorphisms $σ, τ\in \mathrm{Aut}(K)$, we give a self-contained proof of the classification of finite dimensional $K$-vector spaces equipped with two operators $F$ and $V$, respectively $σ$-linear and $τ$-linear, such that $FV = VF = 0$. This classification was originally due to the combined results of Gelfand and Ponomarev (1968), and of Kraft (1975).
